instruction: Read orders.csv and prices.csv. Match orders.sku to prices.code by exact string equality, preserving leading zeros. Each left row must be paired with EVERY matching right row; retain duplicates on both sides. If an order has no match in the original prices.csv, include it once with price 2.50. Compute the sum of orders.qty multiplied by the price of each retained pair. The sum of zero pairs is 0. Use every CSV row, including rows after the previews. Quantities and prices may be signed decimals. Return the exact decimal sum without rounding. Write only the numeric result to answer.txt.
